name: OpenVibe.Report

liveness.means: the process is up and answers HTTP; it checks nothing else

resumes.what: nothing to rebuild: v1 reads Network's open stats and Live's Rundown and recaps on demand; a restart only empties the minutes-long in-memory cache

conditions: automatic: ovhost deploy puts the previous sha back and restarts again when the ready URL does not answer 2xx within ready.timeoutSeconds after the restart (exit 3)
rollback.window: automatic only while ovhost waits for readiness after the restart; manual afterwards, as long as no blocker applies

blockers.none: v1 has no database and no migrations

leases.none: no claims: one process serves the site

notes: Port 5080, unit openvibe-report.service. The Report room (plan 2026-10-28 §5.4): the network's open numbers, The Rundown (what streamers talked about) and each stream's after-show report, in one place. v1 is a stateless front over OpenVibe.Network's open stats (/api/v1/stats) and OpenVibe.Live's Rundown and recap APIs; v2 makes Report the analytics authority (Network's analytics move here, Live's recap and Rundown jobs move here, the external SDK).

site.name: Report
site.what: The network's numbers open to everyone, what streamers talked about in The Rundown, and every stream's after-show report, each number with its definition and its date.
